description: Defines an abstract class 'SugarRelationship' for managing relationships between modules in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationships, as well as handling related beans and relationship metadata.

classes.name: SugarRelationship
classes.description: An abstract class representing a relationship between two modules, providing methods for managing links, relationship metadata, and related beans.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a relationship between two beans.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a relationship between two beans.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Abstract method to load relationship data for a given link.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to get the query for loading a link.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Abstract method to get the join query for related modules.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a relationship exists between two beans.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the relationship table.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all related beans from a link.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a relationship row by its ID.

methods.name: getRHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the right-hand side module.

methods.name: getLHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the left-hand side module.

methods.name: getLHSLink
methods.description: Returns the left link in the relationship.

methods.name: getRHSLink
methods.description: Returns the right link in the relationship.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields stored on the relationship.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a relationship row with given data.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates a relationship row by ID.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Marks relationship rows as deleted based on conditions.

methods.name: checkExisting
methods.description: Checks if a relationship row already exists for given data.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Constructs SQL condition for relationship role filtering.

methods.name: getCustomLogicArguments
methods.description: Prepares arguments for custom logic hooks.

methods.name: callBeforeAdd
methods.description: Triggers 'before_relationship_add' hook.

methods.name: callAfterAdd
methods.description: Triggers 'after_relationship_add' hook.

methods.name: callBeforeDelete
methods.description: Triggers 'before_relationship_delete' hook.

methods.name: callAfterDelete
methods.description: Triggers 'after_relationship_delete' hook.

methods.name: getOptionalWhereClause
methods.description: Builds optional SQL where clause based on provided array.

methods.name: addToResaveList
methods.description: Adds a bean to the static resave list.

methods.name: resaveRelatedBeans
methods.description: Resaves all beans in the static resave list.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Determines if the relationship is a parent (flex) relationship.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access properties or computed attributes.
